title: Recipe Book
story: Grandma's secret lasagna. That Thai curry you perfected. The chocolate chip cookies everyone requests. Recipes are treasures — organize them, search by name or ingredient, scale servings for a dinner party, and never lose a recipe again. Build your digital recipe box.
why: The recipe book combines structs for recipes/ingredients, Vec for collections, search algorithms, scaling logic, and menu-based browsing — a complete domain application.
analogy: A recipe box on the kitchen counter with index cards organized by category. Pull out 'Italian', flip through 'pasta', find Grandma's lasagna. Scale it from 4 to 12 servings for the family reunion. Your digital recipe box is searchable, scalable, and never stains with tomato sauce.
try_it: Add unit conversion for ingredients (cups to ml, ounces to grams). Add tags/categories (Italian, Vegan, Dessert, Breakfast). Add a 'shopping list' generator that combines ingredients from selected recipes. Add nutritional info per serving.
tips: Search by ingredient name with partial matching — 'chicken' finds 'chicken breast'
Scaling: multiply each ingredient quantity by (new_servings / original_servings)
Filter by multiple criteria: time ≤ 30 AND vegetarian AND serves 2-4
common_mistakes: Scaling with integer division truncating 1.5 to 1 — use Float64 for quantities
Search that requires exact match — 'chicken' should find 'Chicken Breast'
Adding ingredients to a recipe after creation — need to update the recipe in-place
